description:
‘I want to be proposed to by a wealthy man! I’m confident I could work hard as a housewife!’

Han Sol, an aspiring model wife and teacher at Sunshine Kindergarten, is busy living his life today, searching for the husband who will turn him into Cinderella.

His biggest interest lately is Yoo Shin, a single dad and parent at the kindergarten. His affectionate smile, handsome face, killer bum, sexy biceps, and even sexier, jaw-dropping foreign car.

And now, Yoo-shin suddenly asks Han-sol out on a date?! Could Han-sol finally realise the dream he's cherished for so long?

Thought he was an aspiring model wife, but turns out he's an aspiring slave! A perfect reversal where everything is flawless—down to the damn perfect master!
A slave-training romantic comedy!
